deliverables: A pull request to vericairn-example-app, merged after its checks pass on Linux, macOS and Windows
body.exitQuestion: Does tally --json print one parseable object per input with its counts, tested, with errors still on standard error?
body.intent: Scripts that use tally need its counts in a form they can parse without splitting text.
scope: --json prints one JSON object per input, with path (null for standard input), lines, words and characters
Errors still go to standard error, and the exit code is 1 when any input could not be read
Tests for the JSON output, including standard input and an unreadable file
body.title: Machine-readable counts with --json
